instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's color constants (#F4F3F0 Canvas, #FFFFFF Cards, #1C1917 Ink, rgba(28,25,23,0.62) Secondary text, #F8C9AE Peach, #FDF6F1 Soft tint 1, #FFFBF2 Soft tint 2, #2A2421 Dark warm card, #4FB286 Green, #E8B04A Amber, #D9534F Red).

All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-try-it-btn', data-testid='hero-try-it-btn', data-testid='mock-preview-upload-input', data-testid='approve-job-btn', etc.).
Install and integrate lenis smooth scrolling for high-end Awwwards weight feel.
Implement Maggie custom mascot: clean SVG vector with warm peach/amber accents for the 1.2s loader and helper badge.
The 'Try it' button across the page must trigger the interactive 4-step Mock Preview Modal with realistic job cards, draft review, and interactive approve/pause triggers.
Ensure the hero has kinetic masked line reveals, dynamic tilt on the product card stack, and clean responsive bento layout.
No fake testimonials, no fake user quotes, no pricing plans. Maintain the clean 'Controlled Automation Premium' positioning.
